renters-rights-act-2025-landlord-complia.who: Designed for private landlords in England — including portfolio landlords, accidental landlords, first-time landlords, student landlords and property owners who use letting or managing agents.
renters-rights-act-2025-landlord-complia.scope: This Blueprint covers the private rented sector in England only. Different tenancy legislation applies in Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland.

author.heading: Edward Omoba writes to make the law make sense.
author.bio: A qualified solicitor in the UK, Edward stepped back from active legal practice to devote his time to a different kind of work: helping ordinary people understand the legal and regulatory issues that affect their everyday lives.
author.note: Edward’s books are written for general informational and educational purposes only. Nothing in them should be taken as legal advice, and readers facing a specific legal issue should consult a qualified professional.
